description: This file contains implementation code for rewriting atomic counters in shader translation, including functions for creating constants, declaring buffers, and traversing the AST to replace atomic counter usage with storage buffer references.

classes.name: RewriteAtomicCountersTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class that rewrites atomic counter variables and function calls to use storage buffers instead.

methods.name: DeclareAtomicCountersBuffers
methods.description: Declares a storage buffer array for atomic counters.

methods.name: CreateUIntConstant
methods.description: Creates a constant unsigned integer node.

methods.name: CreateAtomicCounterConstant
methods.description: Creates a constant structure representing an atomic counter's binding and offset.

methods.name: CreateAtomicCounterRef
methods.description: Creates a reference to an atomic counter within the storage buffer based on binding and offset.

methods.name: RewriteAtomicCounters
methods.description: Main function that applies the rewriting pass on the AST.
